what_happened: The operator revised docs/design/job-planning.md to revision 2 by hand, outside any job. The revision settled eleven Medium findings from an independent review (F1, F5, F6, F10, F11, F14, F15, F16, F18 to F20) and split jobs 3 and 5. Section 12 maps each finding to the place it is settled. The review verdict was "build after the listed fixes", so the operator made the design decisions before the build jobs start. No job failed or was rejected. Policy tests pass on the revision.
cause: Athena's pipeline has no stage that designs, critiques or revises a job's plan, and no job type for turning review findings into a revised design. Design judgment, including settling reviewer findings, therefore sits only with the operator. The revision is committed directly, so Athena's verifier never checks that each finding is settled. Whether the intervention is logged depends on the operator remembering. The same gap produced the earlier case, and this is the follow-up round of the same design work.
prevention: Build the planner and critic stage that the design describes, and give it a design-revision job type. The job type takes a design document and the findings of a review, and settles each finding. Its acceptance shape requires every finding id to map to a specific section of the revised document or to an explicit, reasoned deferral. The verifier checks that mapping, and the policy tests run in the job. Design revisions then run as verified jobs, not as hand commits. Until the stage exists, the operator's direct design commits should be logged at the time they are made.
proposed_request: Add a design-revision job type to Athena. Its input is a design document in the repo and a list of review findings with ids. Its output is a revised document with a findings-map section. Every finding id must be listed in that section, with either the section of the document that settles it or a stated reason for deferring it. The job is accepted only when no finding id is missing from the map, each cited section exists and addresses the finding, and the repo's policy tests pass. Rejection must name the findings left unsettled. Show it works by running it on docs/design/job-planning.md revision 2 and the eleven Medium findings of review 1 (F1, F5, F6, F10, F11, F14, F15, F16, F18 to F20), and report which findings the map settles.
